purpose: Robustness: a file with a damaged xref table and a 900-page file.
why: The reader must repair or reject broken files and finish huge ones within limits.

blocks.text: Recovered page 1
The batch limit of component Q001 is 85 requests. Operators usually leave it unchanged unless the workload grows. It is documented here because several teams depend on it.
Recovered page 2
The retry budget of component X002 is 50 minutes. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart. It is documented here because several teams depend on it.
Recovered page 3
The batch limit of component Z003 is 81 megabytes. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment.
